answer: A fresh identity is a lotus with no roots: it can bloom overnight yet earns no trust until outsiders vouch for it. Tie reward eligibility to grades from established, non-kin peers, and a ring grading itself sends only a ripple that dies at its own edge. Honest work bends like willow under real scrutiny and holds, while fake clusters sharing no genuine referral edges never reach the quorum of outside validators they need to get paid.
